name: Rumor
description: Unverified circulating claims whose truth is left to the GM

fields.description: A creature of the {{ monster.name }} type was supposedly seen near the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is said to be buying unusual quantities of the material known as {{ material.name }}.
A valuable cache is allegedly hidden beneath the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is supposedly preparing a secret action against a nearby rival.
Followers of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} are said to be announcing—or concealing—an ominous revelation.
Routes through the region known as {{ region.name }} have supposedly become dangerous, though travelers disagree about why.
A missing person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background was reportedly seen inside the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A site described as {{ site.generator.name }}, long believed abandoned, is supposedly occupied.
The unusual item known as {{ curio.name }} is said to have changed hands several times in only a few days.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is reportedly paying discreetly for the following service without explaining why: {{ service.name }}.
It is whispered that {{ faction.name }} covertly enables the following criminal activity through intermediaries: {{ crime.name }}.
Someone with the {{ background:noble.generator.name }} background is reportedly being prepared in secret to replace the leaders of a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
Merchants claim that {{ faction.name }} is withholding the material known as {{ material.name }} to force prices higher.
Followers of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} are rumored to perform a forbidden rite beneath the building called {{ building.name }}.
Travelers with the {{ background.generator.name }} background have supposedly vanished along routes through the region known as {{ region.name }}.
Witnesses insist that the following strange occurrence has happened more than once: {{ event.description }}
A site described as {{ site.generator.name }} is said to become impossible to leave after nightfall.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background allegedly built their reputation on falsified records and borrowed achievements.
Residents of the settlement known as {{ settlement.name }} supposedly leave offerings for a creature of the {{ monster.name }} type in exchange for protection.
Coins issued by a government following the {{ government.name }} model are rumored to be counterfeited inside the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A sacred relic of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} is said to be hidden in the custody of {{ faction.name }}.
A concealed passage allegedly connects the building known as {{ building.name }} to a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
Shipments of the material known as {{ material.name }} from the region called {{ region.name }} are blamed for cases of the affliction {{ affliction.name }}.
A government following the {{ government.name }} model is rumored to pay someone with the {{ background:criminal.generator.name }} background for information about prominent citizens.
Travelers claim that {{ crime:piracy.name }} has returned to routes bordering the region known as {{ region.name }} after years of calm.
Unconnected people reportedly share the same dream about an approaching change at a site described as {{ site.generator.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is said to possess proof of a scandal that could destabilize a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
{{ faction.name }} is rumored to be breeding creatures of the {{ monster.name }} type beneath the building known as {{ building.name }}.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background is said to have been involved in the following criminal activity: {{ crime.name }}.
{{ faction.name }} is reportedly recruiting outsiders discreetly to provide the following service: {{ service.name }}.
People claim that an otherwise ordinary {{ animal.name }} behaves as though it possesses {{ rules.name }}, though witnesses disagree whether the signs are magic, training, or coincidence.
A feared creature of the {{ monster.name }} type is rumored to work for {{ faction.name }} with the protection of a government following the {{ government.name }} model.
A sacred relic of the religion known as {{ religion.name }} is said to be a recent counterfeit, yet the miracles attributed to it reportedly remain genuine.
A respected person with the {{ background.generator.name }} background has supposedly been replaced by a duplicate; acquaintances cite small changes in habits as proof.
Supply carts associated with {{ faction.name }} are rumored to feed, shelter, or otherwise maintain a dangerous creature of the {{ monster.name }} type.
Travelers claim that the creature of the {{ monster.name }} type guarding the place described as {{ site:dungeon.generator.name }} is actually preventing something worse from escaping.
The item known as {{ loot.generator.name }} may not be cursed at all; witnesses insist that it simply and actively dislikes its current owner.
A supposedly celibate adult priest or religious leader is rumored to maintain several adult lovers in different parts of the settlement.
A local noble allegedly holds decadent private orgies for consenting adults and invites officials whose favors are useful afterward.
A famous adult adventurer’s real talent is supposedly seducing adult quest-givers, rivals, witnesses, and anyone likely to forgive an unfinished job.
The guard captain is accused of sleeping with adults they were supposed to arrest, raising serious questions about coercion, favoritism, and abuse of authority.
A supposedly haunted manor is rumored to be used for secret sexual gatherings between consenting adults; the ghost stories merely discourage visitors.
Someone important allegedly obtained their office, command, title, or lucrative post through an affair with an adult superior.
The mayor or another important official is rumored to be functionally illiterate and to have pretended to read documents for years.
A famous hero supposedly pays bards to invent most of their adventures and pays witnesses even more to remain quiet.
The royal marriage between two adults has reportedly never been consummated, and courtiers are discreetly taking bets on the reason.
An important person is said to be concealing a curse whose effect is humiliating, indecent, inconvenient, or disastrous for their carefully managed dignity.
A powerful adult is accused of repeatedly making unwanted sexual advances toward other adults and punishing those who refuse or complain.
A prominent figure allegedly used money, influence, threats, or blackmail to suppress a serious sexual scandal involving adults.
A celebrated adventuring company is rumored to lure or release monsters near vulnerable settlements, then demand payment to eliminate the threat it created.
Local necromancers are said to use the dead as unpaid labor while merchants and officials quietly profit from the arrangement.

entries.name: Ruler better at partying than governing

fields.description: The ruler is rumored to be hopeless at governing but exceptionally talented at throwing parties, winning drinking contests, and distracting the court.

entries.name: Relic may be an unknown body part

fields.description: A supposedly holy relic is rumored to be an unidentified body part with no proven connection to the saint, deity, or miracle attributed to it.

entries.name: The Town Remembered on One Road

fields.description: Travelers returning by the same road independently remember visiting one settlement that no map records and nobody can locate again.

entries.name: Monster Visible Only to the Bereaved

fields.description: The creature of the {{ monster.name }} type can supposedly be perceived only by people who have lost someone important to it.

entries.name: Monthly Room in an Abandoned Structure

fields.description: An abandoned place of the following kind gains one new interior room every month without changing outside: {{ building.name }}.

entries.name: Cursed Artifact Trying to Warn Its Owners

fields.description: The apparently malicious behavior of {{ artifact.name }} may actually be an attempt to warn its owners about a danger they have misunderstood.
Unrelated travelers describe the same mysterious companion, yet none can explain when that person joined them or where they came from.
Ordinary doors, cupboards, cellars, and basements in private homes have begun opening into the same place described as {{ dungeon.name }}.
A bell-like sound rises from underground where no bell exists, and its rhythm increasingly resembles deliberate imitation or signaling.
